AiGenerationRecord.title: AiGenerationRecord
AiGenerationRecord.description: Stores AI-generated Instagram scenarios, slides, captions, and sales campaigns created by a signed-in Google user in the Arka Studio.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner

productId.description: Selected Arka product identifier from arka-acc.ir

title.description: Human-readable title of the generated scenario or campaign

contentJson.description: Serialized JSON payload of the generated AI content

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the generation was saved

/users/{userId}/aiGenerations/{genId}.description: Private per-user collection of AI-generated Arka Instagram campaigns, Reels scripts, and slides.
